content.intro: Convert bars (bar) to pound per sq. inchs (psi) instantly. Both measure pressure, so the relationship is strictly linear: each bar equals 14.503774 pound per sq. inchs. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One bar is equal to **14.503774 pound per sq. inchs**. To go the other way, one pound per sq. inch equals **0.068947573 bars**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> pound per sq. inchs = bars × 14.503774

Worked example — converting 10 bars:

10 × 14.503774 = **145.03774 psi**.

To invert, divide by 14.503774 (or multiply by 0.068947573).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 bar ≈ 14.503774 psi. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Bar and Pound per Sq. Inch both measure pressure; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
